tasks.acceptance_prose:
Contract F-200/206/207 (OO core: XLSX part inventory round-trip; Chart and Pivot part preservation — WO must keep parts byte-identical even when it cannot render or recompute them).

ARCHITECTURE MAP (probe first, confirm line numbers):
- xlsx read: core/crates/wo-x2t/src/converters.rs:7024 XlsxToWoSpreadsheetConverter::convert calls OoxmlParser::new().parse(data) (core/crates/wo-ooxml/src/parser.rs:46), which opens the ZIP via zip::ZipArchive and extracts workbook/sheets/sharedStrings/styles/theme/docProps. Everything NOT in that core set is currently DISCARDED.
- xlsx write: core/crates/wo-x2t/src/converters.rs:7359 WoSpreadsheetToXlsxConverter::convert builds an XlsxWorkbook from the WoSpreadsheet JSON and calls OoxmlSerializer::new().serialize_xlsx(&workbook) (core/crates/wo-ooxml/src/serializer.rs:109). serialize_xlsx regenerates exactly these 9 parts: [Content_Types].xml, _rels/.rels, xl/workbook.xml, xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels, xl/worksheets/sheetN.xml, xl/sharedStrings.xml, xl/styles.xml, xl/theme/theme1.xml, docProps/core.xml. Every OTHER part from the source file (charts xl/charts/chart1.xml, pivot tables xl/pivotTables/*.xml + xl/pivotCache/*.xml, media xl/media/*.png|image files, drawings xl/drawings/drawing1.xml + their rels, comments, VML, externalLinks, definedNames, docProps/app.xml, customXml) is silently LOST on save. That loss is this task's bug: it breaks byte-faithful preservation promised by F-200/206/207.
- WoSpreadsheet JSON model: core/crates/wo-x2t/src/spreadsheet_model.rs:11 WoSpreadsheet { version, name, sheetOrder, sheets, sharedStrings } — this JSON is the bridge format that carries an XLSX through the edit loop, so the extra parts MUST travel inside it.

YOUR DELIVERABLES (probe first, then write the test, then implement):
1. Probe + regression test test_xlsx_extra_parts_byte_faithful_roundtrip (in the converters.rs test module where build_minimal_xlsx lives, ~line 16945): build a minimal XLSX (copy build_minimal_xlsx's pattern) that adds three NON-core parts with DISTINGUISHABLE byte content: xl/charts/chart1.xml (distinct XML text e.g. '<chartSpace>...KEEP-ME-CHART...</chartSpace>'), xl/pivotTables/pivotTable1.xml (e.g. '<pivotTableDefinition ...>KEEP-ME-PIVOT</pivotTableDefinition>'), and a BINARY part xl/media/image1.png containing non-UTF8 bytes (e.g. bytes 0x89 0x50 0x4E 0x47 0x00 0xFF 0xFE 0x80), plus matching <Override> rows for chart/pivotTable content types in [Content_Types].xml and a <Relationship> in xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels. Then: XlsxToWoSpreadsheetConverter.convert(xlsx) -> WoSpreadsheet JSON -> WoSpreadsheetToXlsxConverter.convert(json) -> out bytes. Re-open the out bytes as a zip and assert: (a) chart1.xml is present AND byte-identical to the source, (b) pivotTable1.xml present AND byte-identical, (c) image1.png present AND byte-identical (binary-safe comparison — the assert must use the raw bytes, not string-ish), AND [Content_Types].xml of the output still declares the chart and pivotTable overrides so the file stays schema-openable. Assert all of these — that is the F-200/206/207 contract.
2. Implement the passthrough:
   a. spreadsheet_model.rs: add #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = ...)] field to WoSpreadsheet: `extra_parts: Vec<XlsxExtraPart>` where XlsxExtraPart { name: String, data_base64: String } (serde rename_all="camelCase" -> dataBase64). Existing JSON without the field must still deserialize (serde(default)).
   b. XlsxToWoSpreadsheetConverter::convert: while parsing the source ZIP, ALSO collect every entry whose path is NOT in the 9-part core set above into extra_parts (name + base64 STANDARD engine, base64 is already a workspace dep of wo-x2t). Keep zip entry iteration order deterministic (by_index). For xlsx only.
   c. WoSpreadsheetToXlsxConverter::convert: after serialize_xlsx produces the out bytes, open the result zip, and for each non-empty extra_part ADD its entry back with the exact same name and the exact decoded bytes (base64 decode). Also merge the extra parts' content-type overrides into [Content_Types].xml: simplest robust approach — when any extra part exists, rewrite [Content_Types].xml to append Override elements for extra part paths that aren't already covered (a <Default> for the binary extension of media if missing). Keep it deterministic; byte-faithful means the extra parts' OWN bytes are untouched, Content_Types only needs enough coverage to stay openable.
   d. All existing wo-x2t and wo-ooxml tests must stay green. Existing pass-through-neutral behavior (recalc F-202, sharedStrings dedup F-201) must not regress: run the full wo-x2t --lib suite.
3. Do NOT touch features.yaml (other repo — operator flips registry rows). Do NOT add new crates or deps beyond what's already in workspace. Keep edits minimal and localized (converters.rs is 620KB — no reformatting, no touching unrelated converter code; wo-ooxml has its own tests, run wo-ooxml --lib too).
4. Commit on the current branch with a conventional message naming the test and the contract (e.g. 'feat(xlsx): byte-faithful passthrough of non-editable parts (F-200/206/207)'). Rust at /home/weiss/.cargo/bin, toolchain nightly via rust-toolchain.toml.
